items.title: Judge rejects Trump's claim EPA can dismiss data center pollution lawsuits
items.excerpt: A federal court ruled the Trump administration's EPA cannot unilaterally dismiss the pollution lawsuit over SpaceXAI's (xAI) Memphis-area AI data center turbines.

history_match.title: Judge dismisses antitrust lawsuits over Google’s AI Overviews

items.title: Publishers want Brussels and London to stop Meta's new AI terms
items.excerpt: Publishers asked the European Commission and UK CMA to act against Meta's new AI training terms; the Commission says Meta must comply with EU law and the CMA has called the company in to explain.

items.title: Socialists push for EU law on deepfakes
items.excerpt: The S&D group in the European Parliament is pushing for a new EU law giving people rights over AI copies of their face and voice.

history_match.title: The EU is facing Big Tech pressure to revamp its AI law

items.title: Europe Wants Data Centers. Its Climate Goals Are Getting in the Way
items.excerpt: A German plan to route data-center waste heat into homes has stalled; across Europe policymakers are weighing AI infrastructure ambitions against climate law.

items.title: MOFCOM's New Rules and the Future of Chinese AI
items.excerpt: China's MOFCOM and MOST jointly proposed expanding the export-controlled technology catalogue, mostly targeting subsets of China's AI industry; comments are open for a month.

history_match.title: China proposes export controls on its advanced AI models and chip designs

items.title: Trump says paying communities a 'dividend' could make data centers more popular
items.excerpt: In a Truth Social post Trump said AI data center builders should pay host communities a 'dividend', amid widespread local backlash over power and water use.

history_match.title: Data centers face a sweeping new power regime

items.title: Zohran Mamdani Backs Major Expansion of New York's Data Center Moratorium
items.excerpt: At AI Now's People's AI Assembly, NYC Mayor Mamdani said 'yes' to urging Gov. Hochul to sign the Responsible Data Center Development Act passed by the state legislature.

items.title: Memphis fails to pass 1-year data center moratorium, opts for 135-day ban
items.excerpt: Memphis City Council rejected a one-year data center moratorium in the SpaceXAI hotspot and instead passed a substitute ordinance halting data center construction for 135 days.

items.title: USPTO looks to AI agents to ease examiner workloads
items.excerpt: USPTO's acting patents commissioner said giving examiners AI agents could shorten patent review to one year.

items.title: Brazil's Enter case and the governance of AI-powered legal services
items.excerpt: The São Paulo Bar Association filed a public civil action against AI legal-litigation unicorn Enter (Talisman AI) in federal court; the Rio Bar has asked to join.

items.title: Nvidia's CEO wants every country to build its own AI
items.excerpt: Jensen Huang is touring Europe courting governments to build sovereign AI on Nvidia chips, spreading the AI buildout beyond the US and China.

history_match.title: Experts worry about Nvidia's AI chip sales in China and influence over Trump

items.title: New UN initiative will aim to tackle the military uses of AI
items.excerpt: The UN Institute for Disarmament Research (UNIDIR) launches the first international forum on military uses of AI this Thursday.

items.title: Why Anthropic's draft bill sets $1 billion threshold for AI risk
items.excerpt: Anthropic's draft bill shopped to lawmakers would let the government block AI models only if they could kill or seriously injure 50+ people or cause $1B in damage, a threshold borrowed from California's SB 53.

history_match.title: Anthropic quietly pitches its own AI safety bill to lawmakers

items.title: Maryland Gov. Wes Moore campaign challenges ad, alleges deepfake law violation
items.excerpt: Moore's campaign says a PAC ad on Question 3 uses his likeness in violation of Maryland's election deepfake law and referred it to the State Board of Elections, which says it will review.

items.title: Brown Introduces Legislation to Require Labels on AI-Generated Campaign Content
items.excerpt: Rep. Shontel Brown introduced the Securing Elections from AI Deception Act to bar using AI to deprive or defraud people of the right to vote and to require disclaimers on AI-generated campaign content.

items.title: IAMDDB accuses Israel of stealing her identity in AI video
items.excerpt: The rapper accuses Israel's government-run social accounts of using an AI-generated likeness of her in a now-deleted propaganda video.

items.title: AI 'undress' apps used to target Austrian MEP as 119 MEPs call for EU action
items.excerpt: MEPs Lena Schilling and Terry Reintke led a letter signed by 119 MEPs urging EU and national authorities to enforce forthcoming bans on AI nudify apps.

history_match.title: Apple's updated App Store rules go after 'nudify' AI apps

items.title: US judge orders Meta to name employees behind torrenting pirated books for AI
items.excerpt: Magistrate Judge Thomas Hixson ordered Meta to identify everyone who decided to use BitTorrent to source LibGen/Anna's Archive books for AI training, and whether to seed.

items.title: India to bring new AI law? What top government adviser told NDTV
items.excerpt: Principal Scientific Adviser Ajay Kumar Sood said the government is open to a dedicated AI law and has begun preparing a consultation paper on AI regulation.

items.title: 정부 지원 AI 사업 학습 데이터 공개 의무화…세부 기준 쟁점
items.excerpt: 정부 지원 사업으로 구축한 AI 학습데이터 공개가 의무화되면서, 민간 기업이 자체 비용으로 확보한 데이터까지 공개 대상인지가 쟁점으로 떠올랐다.

items.title: [AI픽] "전기는 국가망에서 받으라더니"…AI 데이터센터 새 규제 논란
items.excerpt: 정부가 연내 도입을 추진하는 AI 데이터센터 전용 그리드코드(전력망 접속 규칙)를 두고 투자 현장에서 논란이 일고 있다.

items.title: Samsung, SK Hynix upgrading China plants to make more advanced chips, people say: Reuters
items.excerpt: Samsung and SK Hynix are upgrading China NAND plants to meet AI demand despite US export-control constraints on equipment.

history_match.title: China proposes export controls on its advanced AI models and chip designs

items.title: UK Electoral Commission builds AI for three-hour deepfake alerts
items.excerpt: The Electoral Commission is building an AI system to alert candidates and parties to serious deepfakes within three hours; a May 2026 pilot screened about three million posts.

history_match.title: UK Election Watchdog Develops AI System to Flag Deepfakes Within 3 Hours
